concerns.text: Task T004 (preprocessing) consumes the project‑wide logger (`code/utils/logger.py`) and writes to `logs/pipeline.log`, but the logger is only created in Task T006 which is scheduled *after* T004. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; the logger must be set up before any module writes to the log.

All tasks are tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe), yet several of them share mutable artifacts (e.g., `logs/pipeline.log`, `data/raw/`, `data/processed/`). Without explicit synchronization these tasks are not parallel‑safe, violating the `[P]` guarantee. Either remove the `[P]` tag or restructure to avoid shared‑state races.
